reviews.title: Mojeek review
reviews.pros: No tracking and a much more balanced set of results, It's British too which is always a bonus when everything is dominated by Silicon Valley.
reviews.cons: Can look a little plain, until you realise that's because it's missing all of the guff.
reviews.overall: It's fast simple and uncluttered to the point of seeming bland, but it does what it says & nothing else, it searches, without tracking, of greater import are the results rendered, much more balanced than any other search engine.
